channel.title: Rwanda - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Rwanda, every source cited.

item.title: New Auditor General faces audit accountability gap
item.description: Claudette Mukashyaka urged to investigate why public institutions fail to implement audit recommendations.

item.title: Rwanda prime minister attends Russia-Africa summit
item.description: Dr Justin Nsengiyumva represented President Kagame at the Moscow gathering focused on expanding cooperation.

item.title: IER and MUA partner on engineering insurance
item.description: The Institute of Engineers Rwanda and MUA Insurance will offer tailored products and training to over 5,000 members.

item.title: Rwanda PM warns youth forum on manipulation
item.description: Prime Minister Justin Nsengiyumva told a Moscow forum that young people can rebuild or fuel violence.

item.title: Rwanda seeks $386 million from South Korean firm
item.description: The government filed a counterclaim at the Permanent Court of Arbitration over a failed 4G network project.
